Messages.Author: mjvtes521
Messages.Body:
Does Mistress Fanchon's controller need to reveal to other players which minion card she pulled from her controller's library? It doesn't say she does, but how are other players supposed to know whether her controller pulled a minion card rather than a master or event card? Her ability just seems to be begging people to cheat. Sibyl's Tongue explicitly says that you must reveal it to others. Really her ability needs to be changed to require that you show others which card she pulled from library. But I'm wondering if there is some ruling already that I don't know about. Can I get a ruling?

Mistress Fanchon
Tremere

Capacity: 11
Group: 4

Camarilla Tremere Inner Circle: Mistress Fanchon may search your library (shuffle afterward) for any minion card and move that card to your hand as a +1 stealth action. +2 bleed.

Sibyl's Tongue
[Action] Action

[Malkavian antitribu] Malkavian antitribu

[X Blood]

+1 stealth action.
This action costs X blood, where X is the number of Sibyl's Tongues in your ash heap. Choose a card by name. Search your library for a copy of that card, show it to all players, and move it to your hand. Discard down to your hand size and shuffle your library afterward.

Messages.Author: cordovader
Messages.Body: You can always call a judge or play with people that do not cheat.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> cordovader wrote:
> You can always call a judge or play with people that do not cheat.
>
Correct. The card must not be revealed.
